argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ports=17410,17447; $out=@(); foreach($p in $ports){ try{ $tabs=Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri ("http://127.0.0.1:$p/json/list") -TimeoutSec 5; foreach($t in $tabs){ if(([string]$t.url) -match '^https://chatgpt\.com/'){ $out += [pscustomobject]@{Port=$p;Id=$t.id;Title=$t.title;Url=$t.url;Type=$t.type} } } } catch { $out += [pscustomobject]@{Port=$p;Error=$_.Exception.Message} } }; $out|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress

note: Read-only enumerate existing ChatGPT CDP tabs on known debug ports; output only target id/title/url
